story.text: Edward and Elinor marry, and live in the {PARSONAGE} at Delaford, poor but {CONTENTED}. And Marianne, who once swore she could love only once, gives her {HAND} to Colonel Brandon, and in time her whole {HEART}. Lucy {FLATTERS} her way into Mrs. Ferrars’s favour; and the two sisters live within sight of each other, ever {DEVOTED}.
story.caption: Within sight of each other
